dependencies: Generic :12 rotated shape/meshing descriptors (PR #108 — unmerged at checkpoint 006)
Generic :00 shape-aware selection/collision/placement (PR #106 — unmerged at checkpoint 006)
Creator-authorized centralized registration of candidate IDs, with nonbreaking schema-1 orientation state
Transparency sorting, depth-writing and multi-material faces in the shared renderer
Working dynamic lighting, alpha/depth order, wall/floor support and light source budgets are central engine dependencies, NOT implemented here
Fabric billow, text-editable signs and usable sit/interact behaviors are not implemented; individual physical pieces and attachment metadata only.
Wall-mounted canopy requires a verified adjacent fixed support; ceiling banner needs fixed support overhead.
M4 fire/heat/smoke, water level/fountain and pulley mechanics are NOT implemented: only physical geometry and explicit engines-disabled metadata
Future manual integration must honor open flues, hearth mouths, hollow well quadrants, dry fountain basins and mounted brackets; do not use a full-cube fallback
